note: Current calibration keeper per ISO — the newest, most structurally faithful run for each market (claude.md #1/#11/#12: keeper = most faithful, not lowest error). This list drives the dashboard's all-ISO Calibration Status page. When a new keeper supersedes one here, replace the run id and re-run `python scripts/build_status.py` to refresh frontend/data/backcast/status.js (the verdicts need the bundles under results/calibration/, which the Pages deploy does not check out, so status.js is committed, not deploy-generated).
